newsitem.title: UK: Major KEPIT holder opts for TR European.
newsitem.headline: Major KEPIT holder opts for TR European.

text.p: A major shareholder in the Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc has decided to opt for TR European Growth Plc's proposals to restructure the fund.
"I am tired of waiting," said the fund manager, who spoke on condition of anonymity.
The manager controls less than five percent of the embattled KEPIT fund. He declined to reveal the exact stake.

On Monday, TR European, which is offering shareholders in the 500 million fund 99.5 percent of asset value, revealed it had received acceptances in respect of 2.8 percent of the ordinary shares of KEPIT at the first closing of its offer.
Its offer has been extended to October 4.
"We found that KEPIT has not yet put any formal proposals on the table telling shareholders how much they will get," said the fund manager.
TR European is offering shareholders the option of getting out of the poorly performing KEPIT or rolling into their top performing European fund.
It says that it has negotiated a programme trade for the sale of KEPIT's assets which will allow it to return as much money as possible to shareholders.

The board of KEPIT is offering shareholders the chance to redeem their investments via a Kleinwort Benson money market fund, which will provide a cash exit, rolling their investments into a European unit trust managed by M&G, or continuing with a new Kleinwort Benson European privatisation unit trust.
It says that the terms of its agreement with the successor funds will enable it to deliver an additional 10 million stg to shareholders over what TR European can deliver.
The fund manager who has chosen TR European said that he had not yet decided whether to take out his cash altogether or subscribe to TR European. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
